title: Phakathi koMhlaba neSibhakabhaka
intro: Umphefumlo ongaqondakaliyo ukulindele kumaphepha angcwele embali kaThixo, ephethe imiqondiso nemimangaliso esavakala kuyo yonke iminyaka. Njengoko ulandela umkhondo wemiqondiso, uya kuhamba ngebali eliphawulwe yimimangaliso - ukusuka ekuqaleni okumangalisayo ukuya ekunyukeni ngaphaya kwesibhakabhaka. Ungamchonga lo mkhonzi unobubele ngaphambi kokuba afumane ingcaciso yokugqibela?
clues: Ndithunywe njengomthunywa kuBantwana bakwaSirayeli neendaba zenceba nokukhanya.
Ukuzalwa kwam kwakuyimpawu engummangaliso — ndize kweli hlabathi ndingenayise, ngokomyalelo kaSomandla.
Ndathetha ndiselusana, ndikhusela imbeko kamama kwizityholo zabantu bakowabo.
Ngemvume ka-Allah, ndabumba iintaka ngodongwe ndaza ndaphefumlela ubomi kuzo — zabhabha zemka phambi kwamehlo abo babebukele.
Ndaphilisa abo bazelwe bengaboni, ndaphilisa abaneqhenqa, ndaza ndavusa nabafileyo—kodwa yonke imimangaliso yayingemvume ka-Allah, ingeyoyam.
Xa iintshaba zam zaziceba ukunditshabalalisa, uAllah wandinyusela ezulwini waza wathembisa ukubuya kwam ngaphambi koMhla woMgwebo.

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verse: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. (43:59)
